start_ray_cluster_head_and_workers: start a Ray cluster head and worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head_and_workers with resource requirements
start_ray_cluster_head: start the Ray cluster head node on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head with qos, partition, and gpu requirements
start_ray_cluster_workers: start an array of Ray cluster worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster.start_workers after the head is running
shutdown_ray_cluster: cancel all SLURM jobs and clean up the rendezvous directory using RayCluster.shutdown to tear down the cluster
manage_ray_cluster_state: manage Ray cluster state including head info and job tracking using RayClusterState to coordinate head and worker nodes
